text: Administrative management is an interdisciplinary subject centered on government governance, public affairs management, and organizational operation, belonging to the category of management (professional Code: 120401). It lasts for four years and confers a Bachelor of Management degree. This major focuses on the study of the structure, functions, processes and decision-making mechanisms of administrative organizations, integrating knowledge from multiple disciplines such as political science, economics, sociology and law. It aims to cultivate compound talents with systematic management thinking, policy analysis ability and practical operation skills. Its application scenarios cover government agencies, public institutions, enterprises and non-profit organizations, and it serves as a key link between public policy and social governance.
